guarantees.claim: timer_limit gets the width-casted value of wait_timer_limit_i
timer_pulse asserts when timer_enable is high and prescaler_cnt equals zero
hash_cnt_clr is the logical OR of hash_cnt_clr_i, threshold_hit, and entropy_refresh_req_i
hash_cnt_en is high when hash_progress_q is true and hash_progress_d is false (falling edge detection)
threshold_hit is asserted when hash_threshold_i is non-zero and hash_cnt_o is greater than or equal to hash_threshold_i
seed gets seed_data_i when mode_q equals EntropyModeSw, otherwise entropy_data_i
prng_en_rand_d is set to rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW-2 -: 4] if aux_update, otherwise to {1'b0, prng_en_rand_q[3:1]}
entropy_configured is set to MuBi4True when st is not StRandReset, otherwise MuBi4False

assumptions.claim: hash_threshold_i is driven to a valid non-X value before it is used in threshold_hit computation
assumptions.risk: X propagation on threshold_hit, causing spurious hash_cnt_clr and potentially disrupting entropy refresh

assumptions.claim: hash_cnt_o is correctly incremented on hash_cnt_en and cleared on hash_cnt_clr by the hash counter module, free of glitches or stalls
assumptions.risk: incorrect threshold_hit detection, leading to missed or premature entropy refresh triggers

assumptions.claim: mode_q is a valid and stable state reflecting the intended entropy mode, not corrupted or stuck
assumptions.cond: during operation when seed selection matters
assumptions.risk: seed may be chosen from the wrong source, compromising entropy quality and potentially leaking or weakening security

assumptions.claim: st is a valid state from the FSM, toggling only in a defined manner, and never entering X or undefined states
assumptions.cond: when entropy_configured output is used to gate external logic
assumptions.risk: incorrect entropy_configured could mislead consumers into using uninitialized or insecure entropy

assumptions.claim: prng_en_rand_q is initialized to a known non-X value after reset
assumptions.cond: before prng_en_rand_d is used to update PRNG enable
assumptions.risk: X can propagate into prng_en_rand_d and potentially stall the PRNG sequence, breaking entropy generation

uncertain_points.claim: The slice `rand_data_q[EntropyOutputW - 2 -: 4]` requires EntropyOutputW >= 6 to be valid. No local parameter constraint enforces this minimum.
uncertain_points.risk: Out-of-range bit select may synthesize or simulate incorrectly, breaking the PRNG enable update and potentially causing X or deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: The expression `{1'b0, prng_en_rand_q[3:1]}` assumes prng_en_rand_q is at least 4 bits wide. The actual width is defined outside this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: Bit select [3:1] will be out of bounds, causing synthesis/simulation issues that may stall or corrupt the PRNG enable state.

uncertain_points.claim: If hash_threshold_i is X or Z, the reduction `|hash_threshold_i` becomes X, propagating X into threshold_hit and hash_cnt_clr. There is no explicit validity gate.
uncertain_points.cond: hash_threshold_i driven to invalid logic level
uncertain_points.risk: X propagation can spread through hash_cnt_clr to the hash counter, potentially disabling entropy refresh or causing unpredictable behavior.
